idea-plugin.name: Jinja2 Custom Delimiters
idea-plugin.description:
Allows configuration of custom Jinja2 template delimiters while preserving PyCharm's built-in Jinja2 formatting workflow.

Scope: This plugin stores custom delimiter settings and converts delimiters during reformatting. It does not add a custom lexer, parser, or completion engine.

Code Formatting: Automatic code reformatting requires PyCharm Professional. A valid JetBrains Marketplace license is required to use the plugin's settings and formatting features. Community editions do not provide the built-in Jinja2 formatter used by this plugin.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.2.1

Changed

  • Widened platform support from PyCharm 2025.2–2025.3 to PyCharm 2025.2–2026.x.
  • Bumped Java toolchain to 25 (Azul Zulu) — required by 2026.2 platform.
  • Hardened license-check failure mode: any failure (network, endpoint moved, cert expired) now surfaces as a loud error with actionable guidance, instead of silent fallback.
  • Bumped IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin to 2.19.0; bumped Gradle wrapper to 9.4.1; bumped foojay-resolver-convention to 1.1.0.

Fixed

  • Thread-safety hardening in Jinja2DelimitersSettings: removed redundant synchronized on getState; replaced reflective copyBean in loadState with explicit setters that enforce invariants; removed null-fallback paths in getters.
  • Removed silent fallback in LicenseGate.isLicensedOrPending() and ensureLicensed() (was returning true when licensing facade returned null).
  • Replaced catch (Throwable ignored) in MarketplaceLicenseChecker with logged+rethrown exceptions.

1.0.3

Fixed

  • Allowed overlapping custom delimiter prefixes when each configured delimiter token remains distinct.
  • Rejected null settings values consistently in the persistent settings service.
  • Aligned Marketplace description text with the plugin's formatter-focused feature set.
  • Added JetBrains Marketplace license verification and gated paid features accordingly.
